tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search the database of places to stay in Cambridge, UK, and return those that match the traveller's stated requirements. Every parameter is required. Each one takes one of three kinds of value. (1) null: the traveller has not mentioned this attribute yet, so it does not filter results. (2) "dont_care": the traveller has explicitly said they have no preference, so it does not filter results either. (3) A list of acceptable values: results must match at least one value in the list. Use one value for a single preference, such as ["cheap"], or several for alternatives, such as ["cheap", "moderate"]. Only include values the traveller actually asked for or accepted. Do not guess or add preferences they did not express. Pass null for attributes they have not mentioned.

name.description: The name of a specific place to stay, if the traveller asked about one by name (for example, "acorn guest house"). Use null if they did not name a particular place.

area.description: The part of Cambridge where the place is located. Use null if not mentioned or "dont_care" if the traveller has no preference. Otherwise, give a list of acceptable areas: "centre" (city centre), "north", "south", "east", "west".

pricerange.description: The price level of the place. Use null if not mentioned or "dont_care" if the traveller has no preference. Otherwise, give a list of acceptable price levels: "cheap", "moderate", "expensive".

stars.description: The star rating of the place, from "0" (unrated) to "5". Use null if not mentioned or "dont_care" if the traveller has no preference. Otherwise, give a list of every acceptable rating as a string. For example, "at least 4 stars" becomes ["4", "5"].

type.description: The kind of accommodation. Use null if not mentioned or "dont_care" if the traveller has no preference. Otherwise, give a list of acceptable kinds: "guesthouse" (a guest house or B&B) or "hotel".

parking.description: Whether the place offers parking. Use null if not mentioned or "dont_care" if the traveller has no preference. Use ["yes"] if they need parking. Use ["no"] only if they specifically want a place without parking.

internet.description: Whether the place offers internet or wifi. Use null if not mentioned or "dont_care" if the traveller has no preference. Use ["yes"] if they need internet. Use ["no"] only if they specifically want a place without internet.

tools.description: Search the database of places to stay in Cambridge, UK, and return the ones that match the traveller's requirements. Every parameter is required and accepts one of three kinds of value, which mean different things: (1) null means the traveller has not mentioned this attribute yet. (2) The string "any" means the traveller has explicitly said they do not mind. (3) An array of one or more options lists the values the traveller would accept. A result matches if its value is any one of the listed options, so the array works as an OR. Only fill in what the traveller has actually said; do not guess. star_rating.description: Star rating of the place, from "0" (unrated) to "5", given as strings. Each value is an exact rating. To express "at least 4 stars", list every acceptable rating, for example ["4", "5"]. Use null if not mentioned, or "any" if the traveller does not mind.

accommodation_type.description: Kind of accommodation: a guesthouse or a hotel. Use null if not mentioned, "any" if the traveller does not mind, or an array of acceptable kinds.

parking.description: Whether the place offers parking. Use ["with_parking"] if the traveller needs parking. Use ["without_parking"] only if they specifically want a place without it. Use null if not mentioned, or "any" if the traveller does not mind.

internet.description: Whether the place offers internet/wifi. Use ["with_internet"] if the traveller needs internet. Use ["without_internet"] only if they specifically want a place without it. Use null if not mentioned, or "any" if the traveller does not mind.

params.system: You read a conversation between a traveller and a hotel booking assistant in Cambridge. Search for hotels that meet the traveller's requirements with one call of the tool search_hotels. Use only what the traveller said or agreed to. Fields: name, area, pricerange, stars, type, parking, internet. Give name as the hotel name if the traveller asked for one hotel by name, else null. For each field give null if the traveller never stated a requirement, "any" if the traveller said it does not matter, or a list of acceptable values in the traveller's order of preference (first is most preferred). Allowed values: area: centre, north, south, east, west. pricerange: cheap, moderate, expensive. stars: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. type: guesthouse, hotel. parking: yes, no. internet: yes, no. If the traveller changed their mind, give the final requirement. An option that the traveller only accepted from the assistant's offers is not a requirement. Call search_hotels one time, and write no other text.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description:
Search the database of places to stay in Cambridge, UK (hotels and guesthouses) and return the ones that match the traveller's requirements. Every parameter is required, and each one accepts three kinds of value:
- null: the traveller has not said anything about this attribute yet. It is not used to filter results.
- "no_preference": the traveller explicitly said they don't mind. It is not used to filter results.
- A non-empty array of allowed values: a result matches if its value is any one of the listed values. Use one item for a single requirement, for example ["cheap"]. Use several items when the traveller accepts alternatives, for example ["cheap", "moderate"].
Only use values the traveller stated or clearly implied. Do not guess. Use the exact option strings listed for each parameter. hotel_name is the only exception: it takes null or a free-text name.

hotel_name.description: The name of the specific place to stay the traveller asked for, such as "Acorn Guest House". Use null if the traveller did not name a specific place.

area.description: The part of Cambridge where the place is located. Use null if not mentioned, "no_preference" if the traveller doesn't mind, or an array of acceptable areas.

price_range.description: The price category of the place. Use null if not mentioned, "no_preference" if the traveller doesn't mind, or an array of acceptable price categories.

star_rating.description: The star rating of the place, from "0" to "5". Values are strings. Each value matches that exact rating only. For a request like "at least 4 stars", list every acceptable rating, for example ["4", "5"]. Use null if not mentioned, "no_preference" if the traveller doesn't mind, or an array of acceptable ratings.

accommodation_type.description: The kind of place to stay. Use null if not mentioned, "no_preference" if the traveller doesn't mind, or an array of acceptable kinds.

parking.description: Whether the place offers parking. "available" means the place offers parking. "not_available" means it does not. Use null if not mentioned, "no_preference" if the traveller doesn't mind, or an array of acceptable values. For example, use ["available"] if the traveller needs parking.

internet.description: Whether the place offers internet or wifi. "available" means the place offers internet. "not_available" means it does not. Use null if not mentioned, "no_preference" if the traveller doesn't mind, or an array of acceptable values. For example, use ["available"] if the traveller needs wifi.

answer.text: The traveller wants a 3-star hotel in the centre area, with no internet requirement stated as needed (they said they don't need wifi, so internet is not a filter requirement—they don't require it; I'll treat it as "any"). Parking, price range, and accommodation type were not mentioned, so they are null.
